_comment: ADD A NEW TEST: append an object below, and add a tests/<id>.json file + an ANSWER_KEYS['<id>'] block in Code.gs. The 'id' MUST equal the filename in tests/ (without .json).

tests.title: Geography-Test 1
tests.subject: Geography
tests.description: Physical & Indian geography — IAU planets, Himalayas, rivers, climate, minerals, ports & PYQs.

tests.title: Geography-Test 2
tests.subject: Geography
tests.description: 60 fresh Geography MCQs — geomorphology, climatology, oceanography, Indian physiography, rivers, soils & minerals.

tests.title: Ancient History-Test 1
tests.subject: Ancient History
tests.description: 50 MCQs — Stone Age, Indus Valley, Vedic Age, Mahajanapadas, Mauryas, Guptas & more; 10 tagged CDS PYQs.

tests.title: Ancient & Medieval History-Test 1
tests.subject: History
tests.description: 60 MCQs — Ancient (Stone Age → Guptas, South India) + Medieval (Delhi Sultanate, Vijayanagara, Mughals); 25 tagged CDS PYQs.

tests.title: Modern India-Test 1
tests.subject: History
tests.description: 60 MCQs — British conquest, 1857, socio-religious reform, national movement & Gandhian era; 19 tagged CDS PYQs.

tests.title: Full History-Test 1
tests.subject: History
tests.description: 60 MCQs across the full History syllabus — Ancient, Medieval & Modern India; 20 tagged CDS PYQs.

tests.title: Geography + History-Test 1
tests.subject: GS
tests.description: 60 combined MCQs — Geography (physical, climate, oceans, Indian) + History (Ancient, Medieval, Modern).

tests.title: Polity-Test 1
tests.subject: Polity
